description: Explore one ProgramBench reference program and publish a linked requirements Issue.

agent_card.name: requirements-mining
agent_card.description: Collects black-box evidence and creates a requirements Issue. Input can come from a mining task Issue or repository ChatBot.

capabilities.title: Black-box requirements mining
capabilities.description: Resolve a ProgramBench program name, run it, and publish a new requirements Issue with real inputs, outputs, and exit codes. Honor exact user-specified probes. Link back to an originating mining task Issue; close that task only when its author permits it. Does not create specification PRs.
capabilities.when_to_use: Select when an Issue or ChatBot asks to explore one ProgramBench program. Name it as 'ProgramBench program NAME' or use its exact ID if already provided. A unique program name is enough. Do not route an Issue that already contains mining evidence for specification authoring back to mining.

commands.name: /mine
commands.description: Explore one ProgramBench program by name or exact catalog ID.
